provenance.statement: A reviewed bootstrap-authority Release PR authorizes the first public lifecycle authority.

changes.rationale: Return each refreshed Release PR to draft, create its native required checks with a repository-scoped GitHub App token, and bind authorization dispatch to the event-specific exact head.
Generate a reviewed Release PR and deterministically publish its immutable tag, release assets, PyPI distributions, and adoption candidates after merge.
Build from a clean tracked snapshot and bind cross-platform source, dependency, output, timeout, and artifact evidence without generated-state contamination.
Bind event-dispatched independent review to the exact synthesized pull-request payload and preserve bounded cross-platform process cleanup under transient kernel accounting races.
Dispatch base-controlled release authorization to the explicit producer repository from successful native or emergency exact-head CI and revalidate its immutable run identity before approval.
Export portable completed-lifecycle evidence and cross-check release identity, immutable assets, distribution attestations, main ancestry, and public N-1 authority.
Generate one complete hash-locked, rollback-safe process adoption candidate with managed assets and consumer-owned target-version migration.
Enforce production quality dimensions, bounded selective impact, current immutable evidence, and independent review throughout the portable lifecycle.
